props.animation_script:
// =============================================================================

// Glacies Finis (bespoke). Parametric via a CFG object. Sibling of Ignis Finis.

// Dim the scene -> icy frost particles slowly gather AROUND the target, then are

// pulled violently INTO it -> the target tints blue as an ice-spikes burst forms

// over it; the burst FREEZES at ~2.0s to show the target trapped in ice (held for

// drama) -> then an ice shard shatter bursts on top with a screenshake AND a

// per-target token shake. doneHook fires at the shatter; then the dim fades out.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {"name":"Glacies Finis","key":"master_glaciesfinis","frostColor":13434879,"tintColor":3381759,"tintAlpha":0.5,"dimAlpha":0.6,"dimMs":420,"undimMs":520,"shimmerColor":6728447,"shimmerAlpha":0.28,"shimmerMs":700,"gatherRadius":0.26,"gatherCount":30,"gatherSize":0.028,"gatherMs":760,"gatherStagger":7,"orbit":1.1,"gatherHoldMs":260,"pullMs":300,"iceSize":1.25,"holdAtSec":2.0,"freezeMaxMs":3200,"tintMs":220,"holdMs":820,"shardSize":1.2,"shardMaxMs":1400,"tintFadeMs":320,"doneAtMs":200,"shakeMs":620,"shakePx":12,"tokenShakeMs":520,"tokenShakePx":11,"fadeMs":340,"totalTimeoutMs":16000,"sfxStart":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Ice5.ogg","sfxStartVol":0.6,"sfxTrap":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_Ice1.mp3","sfxTrapVol":0.7,"sfxShatter":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Critical.wav","sfxShatterVol":0.5};

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][GlaciesFinis][" + CFG.name + "]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.glaciesfinis." + CFG.key;

const ICE_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Ice/IceSpikesRadialBurst_01_Regular_White_1000x1000.webm";

const SHARD_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Impact/ImpactIceShard01_01_Regular_Blue_400x400.webm";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

function fullRect(color, alpha, z, blend) {

const a = S2W(-0.1,-0.1), b = S2W(1.1,1.1);

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(color, 1).drawRect(a.x, a.y, b.x-a.x, b.y-a.y).endFill();

g.alpha = alpha; g.zIndex = z; if (blend) g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

return g;

}

function screenShake(ms, px) {

try {

const view = canvas.app.view;

if (!document.getElementById("oni-shake-kf")) {

const st = document.createElement("style"); st.id = "oni-shake-kf";

st.textContent = "@keyframes oniShake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}15%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px," + px + "px)}30%{transform:translate(" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}45%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}60%{transform:translate(" + px + "px," + px + "px)}75%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,0)}} .oni-shaking{animation:oniShake 0.42s linear}";

document.head.appendChild(st);

}

view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); void view.offsetWidth; view.classList.add("oni-shaking");

setTimeout(() => { try { view.classList.remove("oni-shaking"); } catch(_){} }, ms);

} catch (_) {}

}

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = false; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("loadeddata",go,{once:true}); vid.addEventListener("error",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go,1500); });

return vid;

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

// Match the rendered token's mirror: mesh.scale sign folds in Mirror-Horizontal + facing.

const sgx = Math.sign(m?.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const sgy = Math.sign(m?.scale?.y || 1) || 1;

sp.scale.x = Math.abs(sp.scale.x) * sgx;

sp.scale.y = Math.abs(sp.scale.y) * sgy;

sp.angle = m?.angle ?? 0;

return sp;

}

function makeHider(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok); let on = false, tR = true, mR = true;

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return {

start() { if (!tok || on) return; on = true; tR = tok.renderable ?? true; mR = m?.renderable ?? true; ticker.add(guard); },

restore() { if (!tok || !on) return; ticker.remove(guard); tok.renderable = tR; if (m) m.renderable = mR; try { tok.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {} on = false; },

};

}

async function tokenShake(tok, ms, px) {

if (!tok) return;

const hide = makeHider(tok);

const c = { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const spr = makeSprite(tok);

spr.x = c.x; spr.y = c.y; spr.zIndex = 8900;

try {

hide.start();

stage.addChild(spr); spawned.push(spr);

await tween((p) => { const d = 1 - p; spr.x = c.x + (Math.random()*2-1)*px*d; spr.y = c.y + (Math.random()*2-1)*px*d; }, ms, null);

} catch (_) {} finally {

destroyObj(spr); hide.restore();

}

}

// a blue, semi-transparent clone of the target's sprite laid ON TOP of the ice (frozen-in-ice look)

function frozenClone(tok, color, maxAlpha, z) {

if (!tok) return { fadeIn() { return Promise.resolve(); }, fadeOut() { return Promise.resolve(); } };

const c = { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y };

const sp = makeSprite(tok);

sp.x = c.x; sp.y = c.y; sp.zIndex = z; sp.tint = color; sp.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

return {

fadeIn(ms) { return tween((p) => { sp.alpha = maxAlpha * p; }, ms, easeOutCubic); },

fadeOut(ms) { return tween((p) => { sp.alpha = maxAlpha * (1 - p); }, ms, easeOutCubic).then(() => destroyObj(sp)); },

};

}

try {

const points = (targetTokens.length ? targetTokens : [caster])

.filter(Boolean)

.map(t => ({ x: t.center.x, y: t.center.y, tok: t }));

if (!points.length) points.push({ x: S2W(0.6,0.5).x, y: S2W(0.6,0.5).y, tok: null });

const dotTex = dotTexture(cfg.frostColor);

// 1) dim + startup sfx

playSfx(cfg.sfxStart, cfg.sfxStartVol);

const dim = fullRect(0x000000, 0, 7000, false);

stage.addChild(dim); spawned.push(dim);

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * p; }, cfg.dimMs, easeOutCubic);

// 1b) element-colored screen shimmer at initialization (mirrors Ignis Finis)

const shim = fullRect(cfg.shimmerColor, 0, 7100, true);

stage.addChild(shim); spawned.push(shim);

tween((p) => { shim.alpha = Math.sin(p*Math.PI) * cfg.shimmerAlpha; }, cfg.shimmerMs, null).then(() => destroyObj(shim));

// 2) frost particles slowly gather AROUND the target(s), then pull violently IN

const ringR = hPx(cfg.gatherRadius);

const parts = [];

for (const pt of points) {

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.gatherCount; i++) {

const ang = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, r = ringR*(0.8+Math.random()*0.4);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(dotTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 7200; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; sp.tint = cfg.frostColor;

const sz = hPx(cfg.gatherSize)*(0.6+Math.random()*0.8); sp.width = sp.height = sz;

sp.x = pt.x + Math.cos(ang)*r; sp.y = pt.y + Math.sin(ang)*r; sp.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

parts.push({ sp, ang, r, cx: pt.x, cy: pt.y, i });

}

}

// Stage A: slow gather (fade in, drift inward, orbit)

await Promise.all(parts.map(({sp,ang,r,cx,cy,i}) => (async () => {

await waitMs((i % cfg.gatherCount) * (cfg.gatherStagger||7));

await tween((p) => {

const rr = r * (1 - 0.35*p);

const aa = ang + p*cfg.orbit;

sp.x = cx + Math.cos(aa)*rr; sp.y = cy + Math.sin(aa)*rr;

sp.alpha = Math.min(1, p*1.5);

}, cfg.gatherMs, easeOutCubic);

})()));

await waitMs(cfg.gatherHoldMs);

// Stage B: violent pull-in

await Promise.all(parts.map(({sp,cx,cy}) => {

const sx = sp.x, sy = sp.y, bs = sp.scale.x;

return tween((p) => { sp.x = sx + (cx-sx)*p; sp.y = sy + (cy-sy)*p; sp.scale.set(bs * (1 - 0.5*p)); }, cfg.pullMs, easeInCubic).then(() => destroyObj(sp));

}));

// 3) freeze: ice-spikes burst over each target; freeze at ~2.0s

const iceSprites = [];

const iceVids = [];

for (const pt of points) {

const vid = await loadVideo(A.ice);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nw = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 1000;

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5); sp.x = pt.x; sp.y = pt.y; sp.zIndex = 8700;

sp.scale.set(hPx(cfg.iceSize) / nw);

sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.NORMAL;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

iceSprites.push(sp); iceVids.push(vid);

}

// frozen target: blue, semi-transparent clone of the target sprite ON TOP of the ice

const frozen = points.map(pt => frozenClone(pt.tok, cfg.tintColor, cfg.tintAlpha, 8750));

frozen.forEach(f => f.fadeIn(cfg.tintMs));

playSfx(cfg.sfxTrap, cfg.sfxTrapVol); // icy hit AS the spikes come up (synced to the vfx erupting)

// wait until the primary burst reaches ~holdAtSec, then FREEZE every burst

const gate = iceVids[0];

await new Promise((res) => {

let done = false; const go = () => { if (done) return; done = true; res(); };

const check = () => { if (done) return; if (!gate || gate.currentTime >= cfg.holdAtSec) go(); else setTimeout(check, 30); };

if (gate) gate.addEventListener("ended", go, { once: true });

setTimeout(check, 30); setTimeout(go, cfg.freezeMaxMs);

});

for (const vid of iceVids) { try { vid.pause(); } catch (_) {} }

await waitMs(cfg.holdMs); // hold on the frozen frame for drama

// 4) shatter: ice shard burst on top + shakes

const shSprites = [];

const shVids = [];

for (const pt of points) {

const vid = await loadVideo(A.shard);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nw = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 400;

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5); sp.x = pt.x; sp.y = pt.y; sp.zIndex = 8800;

sp.scale.set(hPx(cfg.shardSize) / nw);

sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

shSprites.push(sp); shVids.push(vid);

}

playSfx(cfg.sfxShatter, cfg.sfxShatterVol); // ice shattered

screenShake(cfg.shakeMs, cfg.shakePx);

points.forEach(pt => { if (pt.tok) tokenShake(pt.tok, cfg.tokenShakeMs, cfg.tokenShakePx); });

frozen.forEach(f => f.fadeOut(cfg.tintFadeMs));

await waitMs(cfg.doneAtMs);

fireDone({ ok: true });

// fade the shard + frozen burst, then undim

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; if (shVids[0]) shVids[0].addEventListener("ended",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go, cfg.shardMaxMs); });

await tween((p) => { for (const sp of shSprites) sp.alpha = 1 - p; for (const sp of iceSprites) sp.alpha = 1 - p; }, cfg.fadeMs, easeOutCubic);

for (const sp of shSprites) destroyObj(sp);

for (const sp of iceSprites) destroyObj(sp);

for (const vid of iceVids) { try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {} }

for (const vid of shVids) { try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {} }

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * (1 - p); }, cfg.undimMs, easeOutCubic);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][GlaciesFinis]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 16000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG, assets: { ice: ICE_URL, shard: SHARD_URL } },

meta: { source: CFG.name },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();
